subject: Short-term forensic hold & staged purge request — Aurelia Labs DPA amendment
messages:
From: Compliance Team <compliance@aurelia-labs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-labs.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 08:57:00 -0000
Subject: Request — temporary forensic hold and purge delay for upcoming audit

Hi Marissa,

We are preparing for a regulator-led audit next month and need Redwood's help with two short-term changes to our retention posture while the audit runs:

1) Retain application logs for 120 days instead of the default 90 for any events tied to Aurelia Labs accounts.
2) Delay backup purge for customer snapshots by 21 days (from 30-day purge cadence to 51 days) for any snapshots taken between 2026-05-01 and 2026-06-30.

We know this is an exception to the current DPA. We would like to understand:
- Whether Redwood can implement a scoped, temporary forensic hold for Aurelia Labs only (not cross-account).
- Which subprocessors would be impacted by the backup purge delay (we have a subset requirement for offsite archive systems).
- Estimated incremental storage cost and whether Redwood can provide a credit for audit-related retention.

We will need a DPA amendment or an addendum for the duration of the hold (anticipated 2026-06-01 through 2026-07-15). Please loop in legal/infra as needed.

Attaching our audit notice and a PO placeholder.

[Attachment: Aurelia_audit_notice.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]
[Attachment: Aurelia-PO-placeholder.pdf (pdf, 22KB)]

Thanks,
Clara Ribeiro
Head of Compliance — Aurelia Labs
compliance@aurelia-labs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Compliance Team <compliance@aurelia-labs.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-labs.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request — temporary forensic hold and purge delay for upcoming audit

Hi Clara — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the audit notice. We can support a scoped temporary forensic hold, but I want to be explicit about the operational and contractual pieces so there are no surprises. Proposed immediate steps: 

1) Scope confirmation: hold applies to Aurelia Labs account(s) only, identified by account ID(s) you will supply.
2) Technical plan: implement retention override for logs to 120 days + delay backup purge by 21 days for snapshots in the date range you listed. This will be staged via a canary first (5% of snapshots) then full apply.
3) Timeline: if you confirm account IDs by end of day 2026-05-25, infra can implement a canary by 2026-05-28 and full staging by 2026-05-31.
4) DPA amendment: legal will need to sign an addendum covering the exception window (target dates 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-15). I am attaching an initial DPA amendment draft for your review.
5) Cost/credits: I can get a quick estimate — this will be incremental storage + snapshot retention ops. We will propose a one-off credit for audit retention pending procurement sign-off.

Looping in Karthik to confirm which subprocessors we need to notify and the technical impact. Evelyn — can you flag any compliance gating points on the DPA wording?

Attached: Aurelia_DPA_amend_draft.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Aurelia_DPA_amend_draft.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clara Ribeiro <compliance@aurelia-labs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:37:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request — temporary forensic hold and purge delay for upcoming audit

Marissa / Clara — technical details and implications below.

Short answers: yes, we can do a scoped hold + staged purge delay. Impact and plan: 

- Subprocessors affected: TerraVault (offsite cold-storage), GlacierOps (long-term archival), HelixStorage (snapshot management). All three will need a notification; TerraVault and GlacierOps maintain independent retention schedules and will require a scheduling API call to hold snapshot tombstones.

- Implementation approach:
  * Step 0: Confirm customer account IDs and exact snapshot tag patterns (we can exclude system snapshots).
  * Step 1 (Canary): Mark 5% of Aurelia snapshots taken in the target range as "retain-exception" in our metadata store. This toggles the purge lambda to skip tombstoning for 21 extra days. Canary runtime: ~2 hours to apply and validate.
  * Step 2 (Full apply): Once canary validated, apply to remaining snapshots. Full apply runtime: ~4–6 hours; propagation across TerraVault/GlacierOps may take up to 24 hours for metadata sync.

- Logs: We will extend application log TTL from 90 to 120 days for the specified account IDs by adjusting our log-ttl config. This is reversible after the hold window. No code change required; config rollout via feature flag.

- Risk & rollback: If we see unexpected storage spike or backup throughput issues, we will abort the full apply and revert canary tags. Restoring the original purge cadence requires triggering the purge job to process pending tombstones; that job can be scoped and rate-limited to avoid spikes.

- Cost: Ballpark incremental storage estimate for 21 extra days across your current snapshot set: $3.5K–$8K (depends on size distribution). Kicking a precise number requires your account snapshot size histogram.

- Audit evidence: We can export an operations runbook and a retention-change audit log showing the flag flips and subprocessors notified.

Action items for Aurelia: send account IDs and a snapshot size histogram (CSV) by EOD 2026-05-25. Procurement PO will help expedite internal approvals.

Ben — can you prepare the notification text for TerraVault/GlacierOps and a short cost table we can share with procurement?

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Compliance Team <compliance@aurelia-labs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2026 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request — temporary forensic hold and purge delay for upcoming audit

Clara — thanks. We received the PO placeholder and the audit notice. Two quick items before we schedule the canary: 

1) Scope confirmation: please confirm the following account IDs and snapshot tags you want included: AUR-9812, AUR-9812-prod-snap-*, AUR-9812-test-snap-*. If other accounts should be included, list them explicitly.

2) DPA amendment: I attached the DocuSign link to the proposed addendum — it mirrors the scope, dates (2026-06-01 to 2026-07-15), and rollback obligations. We added a clause for subprocessors so we can notify TerraVault/GlacierOps and they will sign their acknowledgment. Please review and sign by 2026-05-28 to keep the schedule.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC12345
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AureliaRetentionPlan

Cost estimate: Ben will send a short table. We will propose a one-off credit pending procurement approval; credit amount to be determined after we receive the snapshot histogram.

Attachments: Aurelia_DPA_amend_draft.pdf (for legal review), aurelia-PO-9482.pdf (PO placeholder).

If you confirm the IDs now we can kick the canary on 2026-05-28.

Best,
Marissa
[Attachment: aurelia-PO-9482.pdf (pdf, 22KB)]

From: Compliance Team <compliance@aurelia-labs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-labs.com, Jeff Turner <jeff.turner@externaudits.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2026 15:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request — temporary forensic hold and purge delay for upcoming audit

Thanks, Marissa and team. Confirming scope and timelines:

- Account IDs confirmed: AUR-9812 (production), AUR-9813 (staging). Include snapshot tag patterns AUR-9812-* and AUR-9813-*.
- We will sign the DPA addendum via DocuSign today and provide a signed PO. PO number: 9482. Attached the PO.
- Snapshot histogram attached — totals and per-snapshot sizes included.

We accept the staged approach and understand the rollback plan. Please proceed with canary on 2026-05-28. We will monitor and provide immediate feedback.

Thanks for the quick turn.
Clara Ribeiro
Head of Compliance — Aurelia Labs
